current_release: The published first-round checkpoint stays available.
design_evidence: The first-round date-picker miss motivated protecting the original model's channel choice on more complex screens.
calibration: Seed 73 in the five BrowserGym environments, plus the original form and shopping development case. Use activations from nine screens only. Preserve original answer-vs-thinking scores on the social feed, date picker and flight booking screens, including their open calendars. Exchange the scores on inbox, autocomplete, form and shopping development screens.
method: One closed-form least-squares calculation over forward activations modifies two BF16 output rows. No action labels, reward optimization, gradient steps, or runtime switches.

validation.controls: Identical model worker, prompts, browser tools, greedy decoding, warm checkpoints and per-decision token cap. Alternate arm order within each panel.
validation.report: Count every attempted episode. List original-only and candidate-only successes. Compare elapsed time on joint successes. A claim of preserved success on the tested cases requires every original success to remain a success for the candidate. Report limitations even when aggregate success counts match.
